crop.notes: Whole 'Life in St. Louis' column of local paragraphs; only the last paragraph (Gilbert-Allen fight) is about Allen

ocr.notes: Minor errors; Allen paragraph reads correctly

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that the £100 stakes had been posted for the fight between Tompkins Gilbert, champion of England, and Tom Allen, set for October 29 in the London district under the new London prize-ring rules.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Dispatch, Friday Evening, September 28, 1877; pre-1878-12 Dispatch items are filed as the St. Louis Evening Dispatch

facts.fact: Allen was matched to fight Tompkins Gilbert in the London district on October 29, 1877, at catch weights under the new London prize-ring rules; all £100 stakes had been posted
